_archive.note: UNPUBLISHED DRAFT. Differs from v27 on max_call_duration_ms (900000 -> 720000) and end_call_after_silence_ms (unset -> 60000). Its flow v28 is byte-identical to flow v27 apart from version fields, so no separate flow file.

post_call_analysis_data.description: The kind of trip booked or discussed: airport arrival, airport departure, or charter (point-to-point or hourly).
post_call_analysis_data.name: trip_type

post_call_analysis_data.description: The date of pickup or flight, as discussed on the call - resolved to an absolute calendar date using the year and date the call actually took place. Never default to a stale or training-data year (e.g. 2024); if the agent stated a specific resolved date during the call, use that exact date and year.
post_call_analysis_data.name: pickup_date
pickup_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: The pickup time, or flight time used to derive it.

post_call_analysis_data.name: passenger_count
post_call_analysis_data.description: Number of passengers for the trip.

post_call_analysis_data.name: bag_count
post_call_analysis_data.description: Number of bags/luggage pieces for the trip.
The vehicle class quoted or assigned for the trip (e.g. Executive Sedan, Executive SUV, Sprinter Van, Stretch Limousine).
post_call_analysis_data.name: vehicle_class

post_call_analysis_data.description: Airline and flight number, if this was an airport trip.
post_call_analysis_data.name: airline_flight

post_call_analysis_data.description: The city for the non-airport end of the trip - the drop-off city on an arrival, the pickup city on a departure, or the starting city for a charter.
post_call_analysis_data.name: origin_city
dropoff_address
post_call_analysis_data.description: The drop-off address or destination for the trip.

post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The name given for the reservation contact.
The mobile number given for the reservation contact.
post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_mobile
caller_email
post_call_analysis_data.description: The email address given for the reservation contact.
The name requested on the meet-and-greet sign, if applicable.
post_call_analysis_data.name: sign_text

post_call_analysis_data.description: Gate code or entry instructions given for a residential pickup or drop-off, if any.
post_call_analysis_data.name: gate_code

post_call_analysis_data.description: Any special notes given for the driver.
post_call_analysis_data.name: special_notes

post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether one or more child seats were requested and, if so, the type of each (infant, convertible, or booster).
post_call_analysis_data.name: child_seats
sms_consent
post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether the caller agreed to receive text updates at their mobile number.
Whether a follow-up appointment call about running AI Chauffeur was booked.
post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_booked
interest_level
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's level of interest in the follow-up appointment offer, or in the ride itself if no appointment was discussed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: demo_feedback
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's verbatim answer describing what they thought of the demo.

post_call_analysis_data.name: quote_total
post_call_analysis_data.description: The all-in quoted or committed price for the trip, including the service fee.

post_call_analysis_data.name: meet_style
post_call_analysis_data.description: Curbside or meet-and-greet pickup style chosen for an airport arrival, if applicable.
The name of the caller's company or organization, if mentioned during the call.
post_call_analysis_data.name: company_name
quote_id
post_call_analysis_data.description: The rate engine's quote identifier for the final quote given.
The prior quote identifier that was replaced, if the caller's trip was corrected and re-quoted during the call.
post_call_analysis_data.name: superseded_quote_id
dispatch_preference_notes
post_call_analysis_data.description: Any out-of-scope request or preference the caller raised during the call that dispatch should see (e.g. drinks on board), if any.
